scope: Research 1000 relevant distinct implementations, verify pinned sources and semantic dedup, then delegated agent directly implements minimal authorized guard fix; main coordinator reviews.
policy: Only leased Dynasty guards target existing SummonedGuard Enemy predicate; no unsolicited nonEnemy bystander players; ordinary wild crab unchanged; no new PvP mechanism.
countUnit: One independently meaningful full method or complete declaration implementation site, pinned repo+commit+path+line range; surrounding class/context reviewed. No multiple snippets of same method; no identical/alpha-normalized port duplicates or getter boilerplate inflation.
acceptance: Actual full method text plus concrete control-flow semantic observation, own relevance/limitations and reusable principle reviewed before accepted. Keyword matches and download counts remain candidates, never automatic1000.
legacy: No old armor reference entry counted by default. Reuse only after individual full-source semantic review with original ledger provenance. Source cache may be copied with original pinned repo SHA, independent new observations.
nonCountingAuxiliaries: General infrastructure, mathematical helpers, parameter-only wrappers, inactive/unproven call sites and source downloads do not count.

productionAuthorization.gate: 1000 valid individually reviewed relevant implementation sites plus source verification and semantic dedup; no production edits before gate
allowedFiles: SecondaryMob.java guard-only target/attack/damage boundary necessary lines
productionAuthorization.validation: Offline compile and targeted allowed/rejected target boundary validation; no graphical clients or 84 armor rerun
invariants: do not modify total TODO or create TODO backups
